values.task_boundary: Review the ten declared closed sprint umbrellas and publish review evidence; route implementation fixes separately.
deliverables: Ten separate findings-first sprint review packets
Independent quality review of the completed packet set
acceptance_criteria: Every in-scope sprint has a separate retained review packet
Every ordered child is covered or explicitly excluded with rationale
Findings record severity evidence impact and disposition
Actionable fixes are routed to separate remediation issues
The canonical register agrees with live GitHub and retained evidence
Independent review finds no unresolved actionable defect in the review package
dependencies: Live GitHub issue and pull request metadata
Existing v0.91.7 review and closeout artifacts
non_goals: Reviewing the active v0.91.8 implementation wave
